identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][performance] Collapse routine lifecycle into four commands

values.task_boundary: Delete or combine routine lifecycle ceremony while preserving exact scope, atomic failure, publication identity, and terminal receipts.
deliverables: Assignment-free exact csdlc-review record operation that advances Reviewed
Direct ready-PR publication with active-draft compatibility
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: #5624-equivalent routine lifecycle requires four typed commands including unchanged closeout
AC-2: post-product durable request/evidence artifacts are two or fewer
AC-3: failed validation, stale review, claim mismatch, and wrong PR identity perform zero state writes
AC-4: exact scoped review and terminal receipt integrity are unchanged
AC-5: existing active draft publications remain reconcilable
AC-6: focused Gate 4-7 and complete four-command lifecycle regressions pass under /Volumes/FastWork
dependencies: Current origin/main including merged issue 5624 state
Existing typed C-SDLC v2 store locking, claim, review, publication, and closeout contracts
repo_inputs: Rust standard library and existing workspace dependencies
non_goals: No broad workflow redesign or new dependency
No weakening of claims, review scope, validation, publication identity, or closeout
No compatibility retention beyond active draft reconciliation
